usage: Level-up spell list for the listed classes. Combat runs it only when a wired ability has the same id.

srd.text:
_Level 1 Evocation (Cleric)_

**Casting Time:** Action
**Range:** 120 feet
**Components:** V, S
**Duration:** 1 round

You hurl a bolt of light toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 4d6 Radiant damage, and the next attack roll made against it before the end of your next turn has Advantage.

_Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot._ The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.
